name: Inverse Rendering with Differentiable Ray Tracing
aliases: Robust Point Light Source Estimation Using Differentiable Rendering
definition: Inverse rendering recovers latent scene parameters (camera pose, light placement, surface color) that produce a given target photograph by formulating the problem as an unconstrained optimization task using gradients from the rendering pipeline.
summary: Inverse rendering with differentiable ray tracing recovers latent scene parameters by minimizing photometric error through continuous optimization of light position and intensity using a completely differentiable renderer.
